content.text: {"expertise":[{"text":"Research applies long short-term memory networks and particle filter methods to predict remaining useful life from time-series degradation data, with published guidance on training data requirements and cross-condition generalization.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-00593","field":"abstract","quote":"Recurrent neural networks with long short-term memory (LSTM) cells have been proposed for RUL prediction"},{"id":"SYN-PUB-08928","field":"abstract","quote":"particle filter framework for estimating the remaining useful life (RUL) of gearbox output-shaft bearings"}]},{"text":"Work quantifies and propagates measurement uncertainty through predictive models to generate confidence intervals rather than point estimates, addressing practical deployment challenges.","sources":[{"id":"SYN-PUB-08933","field":"abstract","quote":"RUL predictions are often presented as point estimates without propagating the uncertainty arising from sensor noise"}]},{"text":"Research group operates test infrastructure for multivariate condition monitoring using synchronized thermal and time-series data with statistical process control methods for fault prognosis.","sources":[{"id":"R0822","field":"bio","quote":"multivariate statistical process control, and data-driven fault prognosis including remaining useful life estimation"},{"id":"R0822","field":"bio","quote":"synchronized acquisition of vibration and thermal data"}]}],"fit":"partial","fitReason":"The researcher has strong expertise in remaining useful life prediction and time-series degradation modeling [SYN-PUB-00593, SYN-PUB-08928], but published work focuses on rotating machinery (bearings, gearboxes) rather than oil-filled transformers; dissolved gas analysis is a different measurement modality requiring domain adaptation, though uncertainty quantification methods [SYN-PUB-08933] and practical model deployment considerations are directly relevant."}
